name: Deadly Disappearance (Combat)
body:
Your opponents lose track of you in the carnage of battle when you land a telling blow.

Prerequisite(s): Sneak attack +5d6, Stealth 10 ranks

Benefit(s): When attacking a creature you flank or that is denied its Dexterity bonus, if you confirm a critical hit against that opponent or reduce that creature to 0 hit points or fewer, you can make a Stealth even while being directly observed and without cover or concealment. If your Stealth check succeeds, you gain total concealment until the end of your next turn or until you attack.
